temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth tells Keith she is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stuff and apologizes for seeming short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth's explanation shifts his belief from suspecting personal upset to understanding her curtness as personal stress unrelated to him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and consider offering support without taking her curtness personally.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer of support and agrees to a coffee break, thanking him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is not upset with him but is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: He learns she is receptive to his support and willing to take a coffee break with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his support and is open to spending time with him to talk or take a break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To have the coffee break with her and listen or offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares that her stresses are severe; when Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is stressed and open to his support; he can help by listening.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: He learns her stress is severe, professional help may benefit her, and she is hesitant but has considered it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could benefit Elizabeth, but she is unsure and hesitant; he should be careful not to pressure or offend her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and cautious/anxious about how his suggestion lands.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently support her and respect her hesitation about seeking professional help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his suggestion; when Keith apologizes, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Professional help might benefit Elizabeth, but she is hesitant; Keith is concerned about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: He initially interprets her withdrawal as possible embarrassment or overstepping, then her reassurance updates his belief that he did not offend her; she is processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not overstep; Elizabeth appreciates his concern, but the topic is heavy for her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially regretful/worried, then relieved but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support and avoid pushing her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she thanks Keith and says she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He did not overstep; Elizabeth appreciates his concern, though she may still be processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Her openness and thanks confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks.
